_notes.name: The name in the greeting at the top of the page.
_notes.layout: The keyboard the person types on: qwerty, qwertz, azerty, dvorak, or colemak. The on-screen keyboard is drawn in this layout.
_notes.mode: prose for sentences, or code for short programs that keep their indentation, brackets, and symbols.
_notes.passages: The person's own texts to practice, one string each. Leave the list empty to use the built-in set.
_notes.drillSeconds: How long one drill runs, in seconds. 60 is a minute.
_notes.theme: auto follows the device (Paper when light, Terminal when dark), terminal is black with a green caret, paper is white with an ink caret.
